1) Music volume at game start is now set as per the volume game setting
2) Fixed a bug where sometimes two music tracks play while in the launcher screen
3) Fixed overlapping party and buff panels
4) Added the BattleField
[list]
[*] 	An instanced island reached via portals
[*] 	Various AI inhabit the island, and interact with one another
[*] 	Two factions so far to test the overall system, Kobolds and Settlers
[*] 	Settlers will raid the Kobold Camp when they decide to, and visa versa
[*] 	The AI scales according to the average player level in range
[*] 	Players can kill all the AI and the factions adjust accordingly
[*] 	BattleField entrance count is recorded, as are kills and deaths
[/list]

notes.title: v0.95a
notes.notes:
1) New artificial intelligence for monsters that is faction based, and will produce monster vs monster battles if they are enemies
2) Added a couple of random procedural quests to the Belthar Highway Forest area
    (someone needs to have discovered the quest targets for the quests to be generated at the notice boards)
3) Speed up attacking and spell casting

notes.title: v0.94a
notes.notes:
1) Added procedurally generated quests
          Offered at the Adventurers Noticeboard once relevant world states have been 'discovered'
          Only a couple of simple 'kill 10 rats' type quests for now, to test the overall system

notes.title: v0.93a
notes.notes:
1) Removed bare hand and its requirement for spell casting
2) Added mouse scroll wheel selection of weapons that are in the weaponbar (F1 to F3 keys)
3) Added two Collegium Magicae spells - armour and strength
4) Some fixes to portal instances where experience loss by death and sometimes exp gains were not applied
5) Adjusted enhanced versions of mage spells so the enhanced version cannot be weaker than its non-enhanced version
6) Added a second skillbar that uses F4 to F12 keys

notes.title: v0.92.1a
notes.notes:
1) Reverted recent code changes that disabled the login button incorrectly
2) Added 'fog of war' to dungeon crawls
3) Added a larger map view to help navigate dungeon crawls

notes.title: v0.92a
notes.notes:
1) Adjusted experience required per level to lower amount required at higher levels
2) Added a database cleaner to remove inactive players, inactive time to be based on player level (lvl 1 = 30 days, lvl 10 = 60 days, etc.)
3) Added better handling of server updating, locking and notifications

notes.title: v0.91a
notes.notes:
1) Change room styles for the dungeon crawls
2) Change dungeon crawls to be 'easy', 'medium' and 'hard', based on current character level
3) Move to new, upgraded, servers in US and EU
4) Speed up basic attacks
5) Change the compass bar graphic :wink:

notes.title: v0.90a
notes.notes:
1) Increased character name length to 20 characters (from 16)
2) Moving at normal speed no longer consumes endurance
3) Some texture optimisations to reduce client RAM usage, still more to do
4) Portal instances now run on a separate server per instance to reduce the main server workload
5) Fixes to character creation when rotating the character and panning vertically with the slider
6) Changes to the network transport to try and fix logging in issues for some players
7) Removed the Steam Store, except daily gift unlocking
8) Fixed the mouse wheel scroll speed in the skill/spell panel
9) Automatic showing of the cursor pointer added to a few more panels
10) Armour skill trainer stops conversation if player moves away

notes.title: v0.89a
notes.notes:
1) Low level network changes to try and improve 'rubberbanding'
2) Some client and server optimisations to try and improve fps

notes.title: v0.88a
notes.notes:
1) Added Collegium Magicae spells - Word of Recall and Teleport
2) Entering an instance portal now needs a mouse click

notes.title: v0.87a
notes.notes:
1) Added Potion - Follower Endurance (restores follower/pet endurance when consumed)
2) Added Collegium Magicae spells - enhanced (novice tier) and superior (master tier) versions of fireball and lightning bolt
3) Added Potions - Follower extra and critical healing/endurance
4) Added craft recipes for all the new follower potions, and added them to various shops
5) Added a Recall to Bindpoint magical item
6) Added guild level and tier information to the character screen
